text.name: Information Technology
text.tagline: Manage IT equipment, support requests, and services
text.description: The Information Technology module keeps IT equipment and asset data, support requests, and service history in one shared environment. Logging and routing requests, assigning owners, and tracking status help coordinate the support team. Reviewing equipment history, service costs, and recurring requests also provides a basis for planning maintenance and developing the organization's infrastructure.
benefits: Maintain IT equipment profiles and history
Assign owners and priorities to requests
Review the cost and history of services delivered
